verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Notion ships agents that could plausibly consume external MCP tools, but the evidence only covers the server role. Notion MCP lets outside clients like Claude Code or Cursor connect to Notion, and the client guide is about building clients that connect to Notion's own MCP. Nothing shows Notion or its agents plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
